description.zh: 允许智能体调用设备控制服务 (关闭时为安全只读模式，仅允许查询状态)
description.en: Allow agent to call device control services (safe read-only mode when disabled, query states only)

description.zh: 设备控制权限等级 (需开启 allowControl): 常规(家电与自动化), 高危(含门锁/阀门/警报器), 系统(最高权限，涵盖全部控制及系统运维)
description.en: Control permission level (requires allowControl): standard (appliances/automations), high_risk (locks/valves/sirens), system (highest privilege, includes all controls & system administration)

label.zh: 高危控制 (含门锁/阀门/警报)
系统管理 (最高权限/完全访问)
